entry.title: Roland Martin Said He's Your Voice — Is This True?
entry.content:
Roland Martin Said He’s Your Voice

Is this true? We want to confirm.

Roland S. Martin — host of #RolandMartinUnfiltered on Black Star Network — has positioned himself as the voice of Black America on education.

He endorsed Brian Roderick Banks as a “community voice” for Detroit education.

Here is Brian Roderick Banks’s record:

The Record of the Man He Endorsed

  • 9 criminal convictions (documented in public court records)
  • $49.9 million extracted through charter school operations
  • 140,000+ Detroit children passed through schools connected to his network
  • Purpose Charter Academy and MacDowell Preparatory Academy — his schools
  • Schools that failed the children they were supposed to serve

The Questions Roland Martin Must Answer

  1. Did Black America vote for you as their voice?
  2. Did you ask Black America what they thought about Brian Banks?
  3. Can you name a single Black person you are helping that you are not using as a prop for your platform?
  4. Did you vet Brian Banks? Did you check the 9 convictions before endorsing him?
  5. How much money flowed between Black Star Network and Banks’s organizations?

The Network

Roland Martin is not alone. The endorsement network includes:

COGIC — Church of God in Christ

The Presiding Bishop of COGIC — a church with 6.5 million members — endorsed Brian Banks as an education leader.

6.5 million members used as a shield for a 9-time convicted felon.

Did the 6.5 million members vote on this endorsement? Were they asked?

NAACP

The NAACP — the organization that fought for civil rights for over a century — called for a charter school moratorium in 2016.

Then attended dinners with charter operators.

The organization that fought for rights now provides cover for extraction.

Black Star Network

Roland Martin’s platform. National reach. Millions of followers.

The platform that amplified a convicted felon as a “community voice.”

The Challenge

Name a single Black person that Roland Martin, Brian Banks, COGIC, or NAACP Detroit is helping — that they are not actually using as a false face.

Name ONE.

Every person they “help” is a prop. Every community they “serve” is an audience. Every endorsement they make is a transaction.

The Organ Grinder

Roland Martin is not the money. He is the organ grinder.

Banks is the performance. Martin turns the crank. The audience is Black America. The ticket price is their children’s education.

Kevin Mok called Roland Martin out at the NAACP dinner.

The callout stands. Every penny will be traced.

How We Prove It

This is documented in the public record graph with over 11,600 nodes and growing.

Every connection is traceable. Every endorsement is documented. Every dollar flows through a path that the graph maps.

RICO was always zero-knowledge. The structure proves the pattern. The pattern proves the enterprise. No confession needed. The connections are the evidence.

The graph is the proof.

For Detroit Parents

If Roland Martin is your voice, he should be able to answer these questions publicly.

If he cannot answer them, he is not your voice. He is his own voice, using your face.

The graph is open. The record is public. The membrane lets everything in.
